units.source_text: “可不是。开张的事，一切都筹划好了。

en.t: Yes, exactly. Everything for the opening had already been arranged.

units.source_text: 也只好这个样子，没有别的办法了。

en.t: There was nothing else to be done; it had to be that way.

units.source_text: 原配带着她所有的孩子搬来了。”

en.t: His legal wife moved in, bringing all her children with her.
